tasks-for-creating-a-registry-and-regist.text: Tasks for creating a registry and registering a key on the proved design.
Issue 742. Grouped by pull request and slice of the plan. A task is checked only after the ticket owner accepts its slice.

binding.text: [x] lean-binding-rebound: the plan's Lean binding rebound to the aligned models landed on the epic branch, statement by statement.
[x] gate-synthesized: the ticket owner's and the auditor's gate tables synthesized once and frozen with both input hashes.

pull-request-1-state-genesis.text: [x] genesis-and-recognition: genesis, recognition from the supplied seed and state output integrity, each statement with a check seen to fail.
[x] state-titles-declared: the new blueprint titles in the identity manifest and the declared-additions record; current hashes unmoved.

pull-request-1-state-registration-fold.text: [ ] registration-fold: approval consumed for exactly the change, key absent, one token into the committed address and datum with at least the deposit, nothing else under the state policy; each statement with a check seen to fail.

pull-request-1-preimage-vectors.text: [x] preimage-vectors-shared: byte vectors for the state, active and registration-approval preimages, reproduced on-chain and off-chain, including a definite and an indefinite list and a byte string longer than 64 bytes.

pull-request-2-approvals-and-configurati.text: [x] configuration-record: the configuration record at creation, immutable, read by reference.
[x] registration-approval: the approval mint committing its fields; the open burn.

pull-request-2-pending-registration.text: [ ] three-phases: fold only before the deadline, refund-address reclaim of everything in the window, cleanup returning the deposit after it.
[ ] fold-path-genuine-token: the fold path checks the genuine token reaches the new holding.

pull-request-3-library-create-and-fold.text: Pull request 3: library create and fold.
[ ] genesis-builder: the genesis transaction against the new validator.
[ ] registration-fold-builder: the registration fold transaction against the new validator, from chain data alone.
[ ] scripts-published-once: publication of both reference scripts when no live copy exists, reuse otherwise, and the control that a reference script with another hash is not reused.

pull-request-3-open-datum-builders.text: [ ] request-builders: configuration create, book, reclaim and cleanup.

pull-request-3-commands-and-documentatio.text: [ ] six-commands: the commands of the plan with help snapshots and parser rows.
[ ] recovery-kept: cancellation and uncertain submission keep the transaction identity; nothing is resubmitted.
[ ] command-reference: the user documentation of the commands with its speech.

pull-request-4-devnet-journey-and-refusa.text: Pull request 4: devnet journey and refusals.
[ ] journey-job: the hosted job no-pin-registration-journey runs create, book, fold, reclaim and cleanup through the packaged commands.
[ ] fold-by-a-second-wallet: the journey's fold is built and signed by a wallet other than the booker's, from chain data only.
[ ] refusals-on-devnet: the hosted job no-pin-registration-refusals shows the five refusals of the specification, each with its control.
[ ] creation-measured: transactions and locked ADA for a first and a later registry, as a receipt; the later one publishes no script.

pull-request-4-conformance-old-versus-ne.text: Pull request 4: conformance old versus new.
[ ] old-versus-new-statement: folded, reclaimed and cleaned-up journeys, old against new, in requirement language, with the decided difference.
